description: Boost your connectivity with the powerful COFE CF-05-CT04 Wi-Fi 6 4G SIM Router — designed for seamless internet access at home, office, shops, CCTV setups, and remote locations. Its built-in SIM slot, Type-C internet & power support, and 4 high-gain antennas ensure wider coverage, faster data transfer, and uninterrupted connectivity even in challenging network conditions. Ideal for smart homes, surveillance systems, work-from-home setups, and travel use.
